Synopsis:
    Anthropic has signed a $35B cloud-computing deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda for a ~350MW data center in Nueces County, Texas, developed by Hut 8. This follows a separate $45B deal with Nscale for a West Virginia campus. Both deals are aimed at scaling compute capacity to support Anthropic's growing AI product suite, including Claude Code. Nvidia is also separately reported as a direct tenant at Hut 8's 1GW Beacon Point campus under a 15-year, $19.6B lease.

Relevance: NO — The article is exclusively focused on US-based AI infrastructure deals between American companies. No reference to EU energy markets, German power, or European commodities.
